title: Automatic Data Curation for Self-Supervised Learning: A Clustering-Based Approach
mechanism: Hierarchical k-means on embeddings plus balanced sampling across clusters yields better SSL features than uncurated pools.
adaptation: Our pool is 84% ARTS mono 5-busbar; embed cells, cluster, sample a balanced 30-50k subset across mono / multi / half-cell, CSIR / ARTS, dark-streak cells after de-duplication against test / val / E1.
min_experiment: Winning pretraining arm on curated 30k vs random 30k; same fine-tune; kill if n.d. on out-of-fold relF1@2 and E1 recall.
evidence: R: curated beats uncurated and matches manual curation on web, satellite and text data.

alt_notes.adaptation: Cluster embeddings of the de-duplicated 159k pool (84% ARTS mono 5-busbar) and draw a balanced 30 to 50k subset over mono/multi/half-cell, CSIR/ARTS and dark-streak cells.
